{{Top|leg}}
The '''"Infiltrator" electronics package''' was an experimental electronics package for [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] that was under development at [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] during the [[Galactic War]]. [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Aki'tale]] believed the package was ready for test deployment, but testing of the package repeatedly failed, and it was also discovered that the package could not be mounted alongside [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation's]] [[K-57CE engine]].
